scope: New authored synthetic public combinations of the same16 catalog products. No human-behavior or unseen-catalog claim. Prior32/40/history diagnostics are DEVELOPMENT.

main32.pairPolicy: Same stated priorities, query, budget, constraints, colors and other events. Exactly one declared observed event changes from interest/external anchor to an actual completed purchase satisfying A primary need. B asks for an unowned useful addition. Main targets are not already-owned usable products.
main32.pairControls: Keep unrelated view/cart interests fixed within each pair, but vary them independently across needs and against TRAIN patterns. Event IDs are opaque metadata, excluded from model semantics. Literal event-type/observed-SKU changes are public evidence, not gold.
main32.constraintPolicy: Both intended needs must remain source-supported, affordable and compatible with typed hard constraints in both arms. Preserve real shortfalls; do not pad. Prefer at least4 eligible products for ordinary cases; any smaller pool must be declared before freeze.
main32.primaryAmbiguityPolicy: Write clear, ordinary public priorities distinguishing the intended functional category. Avoid ambiguous cases before freeze rather than forcing an arbitrary unique purchase. No exact full product-name search in main32; normal functional nouns are allowed.

gold.grades: All16 canonical products, integer0..3; grade3 intended first useful addition, grade2 other clearly useful stated need, grade1 weaker but plausible interest, grade0 irrelevant/ineligible/already-owned usable duplicates. Do not make every distractor zero automatically.
gold.alreadyOwnedProducts: Match public completed purchases; all usable-owned products grade0 in main32. No replacement intent in this denominator.
gold.sourceBinding: Preferred/acceptable variants must be actual48 variant IDs and satisfy current source facts, budgets and hard colors.

replacement4.publicEvidence: Owned condition or loss and replacement intent must be explicitly authored public observations/query, never inferred from a private label. Do not fabricate new catalog specifications.

baselineContract.training-popularity: TRAIN-only mean of actual model16-product target distributions, counted per canonical public TRAIN request, not duplicated prompt orders; apply original query/budget/hard guards.
baselineContract.latest-owned-repeat: Same prior plus10 on the latest public completed catalog purchase, using explicit timestamp ordering; retain original hard guards.
baselineContract.owned-only-public-context: INPUT ABLATION: retain original query, budget and hard requirements; background and soft colors empty; retain only public purchase events. Not a zero vector or scalar-disabled model.
baselineContract.shuffled-profile: INPUT ABLATION: retain original query/budget/hard guards; move background, soft colors and whole history jointly from another nonpair main32 profile. Fixed mapping i→(i+17)%32 in frozen A/B pair roster; no same-group source.
baselineContract.purchase-history-removed: REPORT-ONLY INPUT ABLATION: preserve query, background, soft colors, hard constraints and view/cart events; remove purchase events. Do not claim equivalence to old ownership-scalar ablation.
